# Borealis

Borealis gives Obsidian an aurora-inspired, minimalist two-tone look aimed at focus and clarity. It ships dark and light modes together with styled checkboxes, buttons, callouts and tables, Dataview support, seven syntax highlight options, and adjustable style settings.

![Borealis screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juanchiparra/obsidian-borealis/HEAD/docs/dark-cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Borealis"
    author: "juanchiparra"
    repo:   "juanchiparra/obsidian-borealis"
    slug:   "borealis"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/borealis"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/juanchiparra/obsidian-borealis"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juanchiparra/obsidian-borealis/HEAD/docs/dark-cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Borealis to give Obsidian an aurora-inspired, minimalist two-tone look that keeps focus and clarity. Choose dark or light mode and use styled checkboxes, buttons, callouts, tables, Dataview support, seven syntax highlight options, and adjustable style settings."
}
```
